subject: CONTRACTOR PERFORMANCE: AAR Red River Army Depot Maintenance Services
bodyPreview: Sir, Per your request, here is the quarterly contractor performance assessment for the base operations support services contract at Red River Army Depot...

body.content:
Sir,

Per your request, here is the quarterly contractor performance assessment for the base operations support services contract at Red River Army Depot (Contract W911SF-23-C-0054, $38M annual value).

Overall Rating: SATISFACTORY (78/100)

Strengths:
- Facility maintenance: Excellent (92%) - all scheduled maintenance completed on time
- Grounds keeping: Above average (85%) - grounds consistently well-maintained
- Safety record: Outstanding - zero lost-time accidents in Q1 FY26
- Cost control: Good - within 2% of projected costs

Areas for Improvement:
- Emergency response times averaging 47 minutes (contract requires <30 minutes)
- Quality control issues on 8% of completed work orders
- Insufficient staffing during peak maintenance periods

Recommendations:
1. Issue Cure Notice for emergency response deficiencies
2. Require corrective action plan within 14 days
3. Consider incentive fees for improved performance in Q2

Next review scheduled for February 2026.

Respectfully,
Sharon Williams
Senior Contracting Officer
Army Contracting Command
